provenance.what: Sixth live run: both golden sets with tag routing ON - the feature that derives per-document tags at index time and guarantees a question's named documents a place among its retrieval candidates. This record exists because the two stronger designs FAILED these same sets first, one run each: filtering retrieval to the routed documents starved a one-chunk document's context and the repository set caught a refused-but-answerable question (12/13); putting routed chunks first filled the context with same-topic tables and the aveline set dropped to 0.88 - one question refused as scope-ambiguous, another answering with a neighbouring row's figures. The shipped shape - rescue only, no filtering, no reordering - retrieves a context measured byte-identical to routing-off on these corpora, and both sets hold their bars.
provenance.models: Chat: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M via llama-cpp-python, 8,192-token window. Embeddings: nomic-embed-text v1.5 Q4_K_M, task prefixes applied.
provenance.corpus: evals/corpus/aveline in full (11 documents); companion run on the repository documents/
provenance.golden_set: evals/golden-aveline (26 cases) and evals/golden (13 cases), both at accuracy 1.0
provenance.hardware: 4-core CPU container, no GPU; both model servers local
provenance.caveat: On corpora this small the named documents already rank among the candidates, so these runs prove tag routing does no harm; the rescue's benefit is claimed only for corpora large enough to bury a named document below the candidate cut, and remains unmeasured until such a corpus exists in the harness.
